statements.text: main() is the only work this module does: it calls save once and returns its result, so the module holds no state between runs.
The module reaches storage directly through save rather than through an intermediate service.
main keeps nothing across calls: it binds no module-level name and returns the value it just produced.
main takes no argument and is the whole of what this module offers a caller.
Nothing here handles a failure from save, so whatever it raises leaves main unchanged; the repository does not say what that is.

role: Record types and the save entry point.

statements.text: Record owns a single class attribute, key, which Row inherits rather than redefining.
Nothing in the repository says why save exists as a free function beside Row.save rather than only as a method.
save is where a Row is written; the two classes above it carry the shape that call expects.
A caller reaches this module through save; Record and Row are the types it hands over.
No branch in save reports a refusal, and the repository records nothing about what happens when a Row cannot be written.
